findings.claim: Only the exact `ssh://` scheme is narrowed to the host check. Every other scheme now returns network, including `ssh+git://localhost/...` and `git+ssh://localhost/...`, which the base treated as local. The commit message says only ssh URLs naming localhost are local, so this is arguably intended, but no test pins these variants. Separately, a Gitea reached over ssh on localhost (`ssh://git@localhost:2222/...`) is still a git server on this machine. Depending on how the unseen host comparison handles a `:port` suffix, such a URL may be classified inconsistently with the new http(s) rule.

evidence: Reviewed the full diff; the host comparison after the case statement is not in the diff, so port handling for ssh://localhost:PORT is unverified.
The new tests cover http, https and an upper-case ssh localhost URL, but not git+ssh variants or ssh with a port.
